_comment: First-person marine. velocity is VECTOR2 [x, z-plane] — the engine lifts it to Vector3(x,0,z) for the character body; the vertical axis is the runner's y_velocity channel. WASD uses velocity_add_relative for diagonal movement (ADR 0004); snap-to-stop on release comes from the player_stop_on_idle rule (state.drag is unimplemented post ADR-0044 — do NOT rely on it). state.facing is updated by mouse-look in GameShell. hide_for_camera_attach so the first-person mesh isn't visible in front of the camera. v2.5 adds current_weapon (1/2/3) + weapon_cooldown. v3.0 adds 'persistent' (ADR 0006) so HP/ammo/score/weapon survive level transitions.
